cases.finding: 46 calls with mean input 58,889.07 and 29/29 quality pass. cases.finding: 45 calls, mean input 82,000.84, 29/29 quality pass. cases.boundary: Action counts depend on grouping: 12 source-read actions expose 30 first-resolved ranges. Neither count alone represents the amount of source information received.

cases.finding: The shell loop's quoted absolute source prefix resolves Models/SampleData.cs to the Completed tree, but the frozen heuristic leaves the variable path indeterminate because multiple basename candidates exist. The truncated shell output visibly contains source lines 207-431. cases.boundary: These findings supplement, not overwrite, the frozen reads table. First-resolved range does not prove that an unresolved earlier shell command never exposed it. Truncation and reacquisition are not labeled waste.

cases.finding: R-016/C-017 fails: AddToCart/2 returns 500 after two additions of album 1; only one row and total 17.98 remain instead of two rows and 26.97. cases.boundary: The relevant fact reached the model and was retained, yet the implementation lost it. This is not evidence that the original input lacked the fact, nor proof of a condition-level causal effect. The official score remains 96.55; the artifact is not repaired or replaced.
